seo.description: Intelligent thermal detection for early fire prevention

call_to_action.title: Intelligent thermal detection for early fire prevention

content.text: Learn more
Detect risks before an incident occurs

Fires rarely start without warning. In many cases, an incident is preceded by rising temperatures, localised hotspots or abnormal heat build-up. With the launch of Watchtower Celsius, Watchtower Security Solutions helps organisations identify these risks sooner and take faster action.

Watchtower Celsius is an intelligent thermal detection solution that automatically identifies temperature differences, rapid temperature increases and open flames. By continuously monitoring temperature developments, the system detects anomalies before smoke or flames become visible. This provides valuable time to intervene and help prevent damage.

“The first warning sign of a developing fire is not smoke, but a change in temperature. With Watchtower Celsius, we make these signals visible sooner, enabling organisations to act faster and keep risks under control,” explains Wouter Ommeslag, Director of Watchtower Security Solutions.
Early detection makes the difference

For organisations that handle large volumes of materials, waste streams, raw materials or vehicles, fire safety is an essential part of day-to-day operations. Particularly in sectors such as recycling, waste processing, logistics and electric vehicle storage, temperature anomalies can remain unnoticed for extended periods.
Watchtower Celsius helps identify these risks at an early stage through:
Thermal monitoring of temperature developments
Detection of hotspots and abnormal heat patterns
Alarm notifications when temperature thresholds are exceeded
Detection of rapid temperature increases
Automatic flame detection
Real-time alerts for rapid follow-up
One system, complete visibility

Watchtower Celsius features a 360° pan-tilt unit that automatically monitors multiple predefined zones. Individual alarm criteria can be configured for each zone, based on the specific risks at the location.
With a detection range of up to 50 metres, integrated 4G/LTE connectivity and emergency power backup, Watchtower Celsius provides reliable monitoring, day and night.
Designed for high-risk environments
Watchtower Celsius is particularly suitable for locations where heat build-up presents an increased safety risk, including:
Recycling facilities
Waste processing facilities
Electric vehicle storage sites
Wood-processing facilities
Industrial storage sites
Logistics and transshipment sites
More than security

With Watchtower Celsius, Watchtower Security Solutions is expanding its range of services. While video surveillance has traditionally focused on observation and security, Watchtower Celsius adds another layer of safety by providing early visibility of potential fire risks.
In this way, Watchtower helps organisations not only secure their sites, but also protect people, equipment and business continuity.
Would you like to learn more about Watchtower Celsius or request a demonstration?
Contact our specialists.

content.text: Introducing Watchtower Celsius
One of our newest innovations is
Watchtower Celsius

A fire rarely starts out of nowhere. Heat almost always builds up first: a hotspot in a pile of waste, a battery warming up, a temperature curve climbing too fast. By the time you see smoke, you've lost valuable time.
Several incidents this summer highlighted clear use cases for an early heat – fire detection system:
At
the Tomorrowland festival
, the organizers had to hire people to see if nothing caught fire (fire watch).
At
building-materials supplier and waste processor in Lubbeek
, a pile of waste and insulation material caught fire, producing a large plume of smoke and threatening to spread to a nearby warehouse.
At
waste-processing company Galloo in Menen
, a battery believed to have been left in a pile of small electrical waste started a major fire. The heavy smoke prompted emergency alerts across the region.
In
Oostrozebeke
, a fire that had likely been smouldering for some time spread rapidly through a warehouse containing highly combustible wood and textiles, completely destroying the building.
In
Emelgem,

a fire completely destroyed a furniture company’s warehouse, forcing nearby residents to evacuate. Asbestos released in the smoke kept the surrounding area closed after the fire was brought under control.
That's why we built the
Watchtower Celsius
. It's a thermal detection tower that monitors temperature around the clock and raises an alarm when something is off:
a temperature goes over a threshold you've set
a temperature rises unusually fast
there is an open flame

A 360° pan/tilt thermalgraphic camera automatically scans preset zones, each with its own alarm criteria. Specially developed AI continuously analyses the thermal data to identify abnormal heat patterns, rapid temperature changes, and flames. Watchtower Celsius covers a range of up to 50 metres and features secure 5G connectivity and backup power. When a potential threat is detected, an alert is sent directly to the customer or to a connected monitoring centre, which can notify the fire brigade.

We built it for locations where heat poses a real business risk, including recycling and waste-processing facilities, EV storage sites, wood-processing facilities, industrial storage sites and logistics yards—all environments with an increased risk of fire.
You can
discover the Watchtower Celsius here.
Meet Watchtower 360
Another major step forward is the launch of
Watchtower 360

As the name suggests, this innovative unit features a 360-degree camera system, with a more compact frame. You get full panoramic coverage from a unit that's easier to transport, place and set up, even on tight sites.
For customers looking to maximize coverage while minimizing the physical impact on-site, Watchtower 360 represents a significant leap forward.
Check out our Watchtower 360
here.

content.text: Watchtower in Your Pocket: The Watchtower App
With the new Watchtower app for iOS and Android, users manage their own system. They can:
set and change their alarm times
watch live footage from their site, wherever they are
get notifications straight away, for an alarm and also for things like a power failure

content.text: This gives customers more control, faster information and fewer phone calls to control rooms.
From Rental to Ownership
For years, Watchtower has been known for its flexible rental model. That remains a key part of our offering.
However, we are now taking the next step by making
Watchtower units available for purchase
This creates opportunities for:
Construction companies with long-term or permanent site monitoring requirements
Operators of critical infrastructure where towers remain deployed for extended periods
Security companies looking to expand their service portfolio with a proven and innovative mobile security solution
Customers will be able to combine ownership with a range of new
service packages
, allowing them to choose exactly how much support they require.

Some organizations prefer to operate the system largely themselves. Others want complete peace of mind and full operational support from Watchtower. Our service packages will make both approaches possible, providing maximum flexibility while ensuring optimal performance.
You can find more info
here
Looking Beyond Security
While security remains at the heart of what we do, our vision extends further.
Over the coming months, Watchtower will continue to innovate with solutions that go beyond traditional security applications. We are actively expanding our focus into the world of
safety
, helping customers not only protect assets but also support safer working environments and better operational awareness. So the same system that delivers security by night, enables safety by day.
We are not quite ready to reveal everything yet, but I can promise there is much more to come before the end of the year!
Interested in learning more about the latest Watchtower innovations?
Get in touch with us!
